posts.text: Share price movement could be because of the recent positive management commentary. Management is now looking at a bigger push in the private sector, especially BFSI, along with international expansion. They are planning to take their existing digital public infrastructure capabilities globally through a “DPI-in-a-box” approach. They also mentioned that enterprise and international businesses can be higher-margin compared to their existing core business.
